scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @nova/web" "npm run dev -w @nova/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nova/shared && npm run build -w @nova/api && npm run build -w @nova/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nova/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nova/api && npm run typecheck -w @nova/web && npm run typecheck -w @nova/e2e
